creator: kaithevibecoder
title: Four design/vibe-coding websites: Motion Primitives, Manus (sponsored), Haikei, Realtime Colors

tools.name: Manus
tools.detail: manus.im -- AI app/website builder, one-click publish, built-in analytics and SEO tracker (#manuspartner = sponsored)

tools.name: Haikei
tools.detail: haikei.app -- generates unique SVG backgrounds (blobs, gradients, waves); free, no signup

tools.name: Realtime Colors
tools.detail: realtimecolors.com -- test colour palettes and fonts on a real UI before building

claims: Motion Primitives: beautiful animation code, just copy and paste, no animation code needed
Manus is 'hands down the best tool' for apps/websites without coding; publish to web in one click with built-in analytics and SEO tracker
Haikei is free to start and needs no sign-up
Realtime Colors lets you preview palettes/fonts on a real UI
how_to_steps: Grab animation components from motionprimitives.com and paste into your project
Use Manus to build/publish a no-code app (sponsored)
Validate palette + fonts at realtimecolors.com before building
on_screen_only: Overlay: 'niches sites for learning design -- Vibecode design edition'
Manus demo screenshots: an e-commerce page with clothing products, prompt text about 'minimal, elegant typography', 'soft shadows'
Haikei UI: 'Make unique SVG design assets'
Realtime Colors UI: 'Visualize Your Colors On a Real Site'
cta: Comment 'design' for the links; save the video

relevance.why: Motion Primitives, Haikei and Realtime Colors are genuinely useful free helpers for making Claude Code-built UIs look polished fast. Manus segment is a sponsored no-code pitch and irrelevant.

implement_score.why: Bookmark the three free sites; point Claude Code at motionprimitives.com components when building landing pages. Zero setup cost. Skip Manus.

verify: Motion Primitives licensing and framework (React/Framer Motion?) compatibility with our stack
Haikei: is the free tier still unlimited for SVG export?
Manus pricing and whether the 'analytics/SEO tracker' claim is real -- note #manuspartner sponsorship
